findings.text: the docstring records "nineteen committed rows under docs/state/reckon/runs already carry it", a total that grows with every promotion, so a reader takes a stale snapshot as a present fact; the count reproduces at ba1a26e4 (git grep -l '"review_tier"' ba1a26e4 -- docs/state/reckon/runs lists 19 files), and a derived or command-stated figure would not rot — the sibling evidence fragment can carry the dated number because it is a record, but source prose is read as current.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against ba1a26e4; 106e0c16 adds the schema key and the new test, 45f54d6c adds the build_record setdefault with its comment, and 0f3f1dc7 adds only the evidence fragment and the figure.
item_verdicts.done_when: the fence names tests/test_ledger_declares_the_review_tier.py asserting the declared-field check finds no undeclared key on a row carrying review_tier; tests/test_ledger_declares_the_review_tier.py:58 and :89 assert exactly that, and the head arm log records 98 passed / 1 skipped / EXIT=0 across the three named files.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to declare the review_tier ledger field promotion writes; reckon/ledger.py:143 declares it in RECORD_FIELDS beside "review", and reckon/ledger.py:1522 carries it on every built record, which is the field reckon/crew/promotion.py:5441 writes on each promotion.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records both arms as armed JSON with revision, command, log path, failure_count 0 and empty failure_ids, names the base-arm tree and measurement module/cwd, and gives the negative-control log as a bare path with its EXIT=1 and both FAILED ids.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's four declared paths against the diff; `git diff --stat ba1a26e4..0f3f1dc7` returns exactly reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_ledger_declares_the_review_tier.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-is-sized-to-its-risk/ledger-declares-the-review-tier.html and the figure directory, 240 insertions and no deletions.

justifications.durability: the negative control reddens tests/test_ledger_declares_the_review_tier.py:58 and :89, so the declaration is guarded, while the build_record emission rests on the pre-existing subset assertions at tests/test_ledger.py:810, :873 and :1832 rather than on any assertion this node added, and the mount-liveness check at :84 is satisfied by the key the test itself set.
justifications.evidence: head-arm.log names revision 45f54d6c, tree, command, module and cwd and records 98 passed / 1 skipped / EXIT=0, base-arm.log records 96 passed / 1 skipped / EXIT=0 at ba1a26e4, and both new cases fail (EXIT=1) under the declared mutation in negative-control-removing-review-tier.log.
justifications.fit: the comment at reckon/ledger.py:1518-1521 matches the setdefault block it joins and the test imports tests/test_record_fields_declare_every_key.py:_promoted_ledger_key_union rather than copying the mounted-ledger walk, but the module docstring at tests/test_ledger_declares_the_review_tier.py:4 states a row count that grows with every promotion.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:143 declares "review_tier" and reckon/ledger.py:1522 emits it via setdefault, so the key reckon/crew/promotion.py:5441 writes is both declared and always carried.
justifications.scope_discipline: `git diff --stat ba1a26e4..0f3f1dc7` returns the four declared paths and nothing else, and the change adds no capability the goal does not name.
